name: ConnectionFactoryAndUnitOfWork

required_connection_setup: verify persisted journal_mode is wal for authoritative runtime connections
startup_database_setup: set PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL only while canonical instance ownership is held
verify journal mode result before readiness
connection_factory.optional_defense_in_depth: when the packaged sqlite3 exposes SQLITE_DBCONFIG_DEFENSIVE/TRUSTED_SCHEMA, enable defensive mode and disable trusted schema; packaged-runtime tests pin the expected availability/behavior
connection_factory.failure: any required setup/verification failure closes connection and returns PERSISTENCE_CONNECTION_UNSAFE

write_unit_of_work.nested_policy: a second independent UnitOfWork on the same logical command is forbidden; collaborators receive the existing UoW/repository set
write_unit_of_work.commit: execute literal COMMIT after all domain/evidence/receipt/audit writes succeed
write_unit_of_work.rollback: on any BaseException while in_transaction, execute ROLLBACK; if rollback itself fails, close connection and surface PERSISTENCE_ROLLBACK_FAILURE without reporting command success
write_unit_of_work.busy_policy: BEGIN IMMEDIATE may wait up to busy_timeout; SQLITE_BUSY/SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT returns retryable RESOURCE_BUSY and performs no accepted writes

read_query.default: one verified connection, parameterized SELECTs, no write statements
read_query.consistent_snapshot: for multi-query report/projection consistency execute BEGIN, perform reads, then COMMIT; snapshot duration must be bounded and never include operator think-time
read_query.query_only: read-dedicated connections set PRAGMA query_only=ON after ordinary safety setup

repository_rules: repositories receive a Connection/UoW; they never open their own unmanaged connection
SQL uses qmark placeholders only; string interpolation/concatenation for values is forbidden
one execute call contains one SQL statement
row conversion occurs at repository boundary; sqlite3.Row does not escape into domain objects
connection objects never cross thread boundaries
performance_rules: write transactions contain only current-state load, revalidation, bounded mutation, required event/audit and commit
file/mail/workbook parsing and expensive calculations execute before the transaction
batch commands preflight outside transaction then commit accepted atomic partition(s) with fresh revalidation
do not add caches/denormalized truth until a measured query requires a rebuildable projection
